columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text. A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable.

columns.description: Units on the line. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.

columns.description: Capture timestamp carried forward from the bronze landing (_airbyte_extracted_at): the incremental watermark the gold layer builds on. Populated for every surviving line now that the incremental path has landed; consumers can rely on it as a non-null watermark for incremental processing without null-handling logic.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained. captured_at is now guaranteed non-null and usable as an incremental watermark.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate collapse to one line with the earliest timestamp retained. customer_id remains nullable for guest or unregistered checkouts.
